question: Why doesn't settled amount match GMV for the last 7 days?

plan.question: Why doesn't settled amount match GMV for the last 7 days?

headline: Settled net is ₹19.48 L below GMV, mostly fees and refunds; nothing is unexplained.

claims.text: Transaction GMV was {E1.txn_gmv} and settled net was {E1.settled_net}, a gap of {E1.gap}.
claims.rendered: Transaction GMV was ₹12.49 Cr and settled net was ₹12.29 Cr, a gap of ₹19.48 L.

evidence.title: GMV to settled net bridge, last 7 days
sql:
SELECT txn_date, SUM(amount_paise / 100.0) AS gmv_inr
FROM analytics.transactions
WHERE status = 'SUCCESS' AND txn_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-11-13' AND DATE '2026-11-19'
GROUP BY 1
LIMIT 5000

SELECT cycle_date, SUM(amount_paise / 100.0) AS gmv_inr
FROM analytics.transactions
WHERE status = 'SUCCESS' AND cycle_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-11-13' AND DATE '2026-11-19'
GROUP BY 1
LIMIT 5000

SELECT cycle_date, SUM(gross_paise) / 100.0 AS gross_inr, SUM(refund_paise) / 100.0 AS refund_inr,
       SUM(fee_paise) / 100.0 AS fee_inr, SUM(net_paise) / 100.0 AS net_inr
FROM analytics.settlements
WHERE cycle_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-11-13' AND DATE '2026-11-19'
GROUP BY 1
LIMIT 5000

table.note: Sales after the 23:00 IST cutoff on 19 Nov fall into the next settlement cycle.
Settlements include sales we never ingested (PG_C gap on 16 Nov), so they exceed our GMV.

evidence.title: PG_C attempts by hour on 16 Nov (data-quality check)
sql:
SELECT txn_date, region, gateway, raw_events, distinct_txns, duplicate_events, null_issuer_nonwallet,
       max_ingest_lag_s
FROM analytics.dq_daily
WHERE txn_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-11-13' AND DATE '2026-11-19'
LIMIT 5000

SELECT txn_date, txn_hour, gateway, COUNT(*) AS attempts
FROM analytics.transactions
WHERE txn_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-11-06' AND DATE '2026-11-19'
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
LIMIT 5000

dq.message: PG_C recorded no attempts on 16 Nov 2026 between 02:00 and 08:00 IST (6 hours; ~1,080 attempts expected from the prior 7 days). Rates for that day may be biased.
